response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and systems development experience with a focus on scalable, testable solutions. While his background includes relevant technical leadership and experimentation-adjacent work (e.g., pricing optimization, telemetry), his direct experience with large-scale experimentation platforms and AI-first growth systems is less explicit. His cross-functional collaboration and hands-on coding align well with the role, but the Principal-level expectations for architectural ownership and experimentation quality require deeper validation.
strengths: Proven track record designing and shipping scalable systems (e.g., micro-services at Sociomantic, AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq).
Strong technical leadership with mentorship and cross-team collaboration (e.g., workshops, open-source contributions).
Hands-on expertise in relevant languages (TypeScript, Python, Java) and distributed systems (AWS, Kubernetes).
concerns: Limited explicit experience with experimentation platforms or statistical analysis for growth systems.
Principal-level roles typically require deeper architectural ownership; current roles skew toward senior/staff levels.
No clear evidence of building experimentation frameworks or bias detection systems at scale.
